title: ISO 13920:2023 — Welding — General tolerances for welded constructions
locator: General tolerances for linear/angular dimensions and shape/position of weldments in four tolerance classes; classes are stated on drawings; complex structures may need special provisions.
notes: 面向焊接结构一般尺寸/形位公差，不替代功能关键基准、机加工面和装配接口的单独标注。
